user.title: Connect your Tonal account
user.description: Your credentials are sent straight to Tonal's Auth0 servers and are only stored locally, so the integration can renew its session.

reauth_confirm.title: Tonal needs you to sign in again

error.invalid_auth: Tonal rejected that email and password.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the logs for details.

abort.already_configured: That Tonal account is already set up.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll Tonal. Workout history changes rarely, so there is little reason to go below 15 minutes.
data_description.fetch_titles: Fetches the name of each workout template once and caches it. Turn this off to keep the request count to a minimum.

export_data.name: Export data
export_data.description: Writes the current Tonal data to a JSON file in the ToneGet export format.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: Which Tonal account to export. Defaults to the first one.

file_path.name: File path
file_path.description: Where to write the file. Defaults to a timestamped file in your config directory. Any other location must be in allowlist_external_dirs.

full.name: Full export
full.description: Keep every raw API field instead of trimming the unused ones.
